Definition: a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth.
BiblicalUsage: Meronothiy names a man by his town, a Meronothite. 1 Chronicles 27:30 has Jehdeiah the Meronothite over the asses, and Nehemiah 3:7 has Jadon the Meronothite repair the wall beside Melatiah the Gibeonite.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Meronothites are remembered for ordinary faithfulness: one kept the asses, and one kept the wall.
